name: research-wiki
description: Read the formal LLM-Wiki document and the candidate submissions of a wiki domain through the permissioned management MCP. Read-only: submitting, reviewing, merging and formalizing wiki candidates require the Owner-side capability set and are not exposed here.

tools.name: get_formal_wiki
tools.description: Read the current formal Wiki revision for a domain. Requires the read or centre capability.

output.status: string (available when a formal revision exists; otherwise a failure status)
output.title: string

tools.name: list_wiki_candidates
tools.description: Read candidate submissions for a Wiki domain. Requires the read or centre capability.

output.candidates: array of {submission_id, wiki_domain_id, submitter_id, base_formal_revision_id, proposal_id, submitted_at, status}
